headline: 今日无新片，超级少女领跑热搜
headlineEn: No new releases today, Supergirl tops trending
summary: 今日无影片上映，本周已有4部新片。热搜前五：超级少女、蜘蛛侠崭新之日、奥德赛、利未记、群体。未来将映：逃出绝命街及韩影오케이 마담 2。
summaryEn: No movies released today, 4 new this week. Top trending: Supergirl, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, Odyssey, Leviticus, The Crowd. Upcoming: Escape from Dead End Street and Korean film Okay Madam 2.

industryHighlights.text: 《超级少女》继续领跑今日热搜
industryHighlights.en: Supergirl continues to lead today's trending

industryHighlights.text: 《逃出绝命街》与《오케이 마담 2》即将上映
industryHighlights.en: Escape from Dead End Street and Okay Madam 2 are upcoming
